bio: Passionate Flutter Developer with 3+ years of experience in building and optimizing scalable, high-performance mobile and web applications. Trained at Ducat Institute, Noida, I developed a strong understanding of system architecture and application design. Currently, I work as a Flutter Developer at NovasArc Consulting Pvt. Ltd., where I contribute to production-grade projects, optimize existing codebases, and manage freelance assignments. I am driven by clean architecture, efficient problem-solving, and delivering reliable, business-ready solutions.
